title: Agentic Inquiry lifecycle hook request
description: One native lifecycle event, delivered by a host adapter to `ai integration hook --client claude-code|codex|pi|cursor --event <event>` as a single JSON object on stdin. The client is a flag, not a field of this object. Keys outside this set are refused (unadmitted_fields). Length limits on `query`, `observations[].content`, `observations[].summary` and string values inside `observations[].metadata` are enforced in bytes of UTF-8 by the runtime; the code-point limits here are the schema approximation. Keys inside an observation outside content, summary, importance and metadata are refused (unadmitted_fields). The whole document is limited to 1048576 bytes. A request carries observations or artifacts, never both (invalid_payload).

owner.description: The integration owner that registered this project and client. Exactly one owner may be enabled per project and client.

project_root.description: Canonical absolute path of the project. The runtime refuses a relative path, a path with unresolved symlinks or `..`, and a path that is not a directory.

session_id.description: The native client's session identity. Required and never invented by the adapter. Printable ASCII without spaces or control characters.

event_id.description: Stable native identity of this event. Required for any request that carries observations or artifacts; a redelivery with the same identity and payload returns the stored receipt. Printable ASCII without spaces or control characters.

query.description: The user's prompt text, UserPromptSubmit only. At most 16384 bytes.

observations.description: Observations the host selected for durable capture. Never raw transcript or tool output.

artifacts.description: Project files whose content changed, as absolute paths inside `project_root`. A path that resolves outside the project is refused (artifact_escape).

metadata.description: Flat metadata with LanceDB-compatible value types: at most 16 keys, snake_case keys, string values at most 256 bytes, lists of at most 32 strings. The runtime-owned keys event_key, event, project_identity and observation_index are reserved.
